risks.risk: Panel may be damaged or defective internally (e.g., microcracks, delamination, or underperformance not visible in photos).
risks.proof: A video showing the panel under sunlight with a multimeter reading or a close-up inspection of the cells for microcracks or hotspots.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially underperforming or defective, which reduces value.

risks.risk: Panel may not be functional or may have been previously used or damaged in transit.
risks.proof: A video of the panel being tested with a solar simulator or connected to a load to show output.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as possibly non-functional, which reduces value.

risks.risk: The model shown may not be the one being sold (e.g., seller may be selling a different model not shown).
risks.proof: A photo of the actual panel being sold with the same label visible, or a video showing the panel being handed over.
risks.if_unproven: Priced at the lower end of the model range due to uncertainty.

proof_requests: Video of the panel being tested under sunlight or with a solar simulator to verify output.
Close-up video of the panel surface to check for microcracks or damage.
